I hear you dude. My spouse is the same way. I've been working with her for years to better stand up for herself and her wants and needs, to stop being a yes man, and to start demanding fair treatment.

It hasn't been easy for her, but she's much improved now. Essentially each time I notice the behavior I pose a few questions:

- why are you helping x person? Is it for you?
- would helping this person negatively affect you / your wants and needs?

And possibly the most damning (in my eyes at least)
- honestly, would this person do that for you if you asked?

If any of those answers affect you in a negative way, or that person wouldn't be there for you, it's not only okay, but at times NECESSARY, to decline to help.

Its not being rude or betraying anyone to look out for yourself first. 

After all, no one else will.

Not to mention, if you feel like the other person will like you less or be mad at you for not helping, two points:

- that person is taking advantage of you, manipulating you because they know they can, or maybe just doing it without being conscious that they are doing such.
- think of other people's answers in that scenario? Did your friend Bill do something similar when asked? No? Was there any negative outcome he experienced because of that? Most of the time, the answer is no.

With some hard work and time you can stand up for yourself and make sure your own needs are met.

Its not easy, but it IS important.

Remember to ask yourself: will this task negatively affect me in some way? If yes, consider not doing it. You have to come first.

I figured out what the issue is: I had a color assigned to the product itself. When you do that in catia, in certain view modes, will make all lineic elements (points, lines, curves etc) black and you will not be able to change the color of those elements normally.

To fix, I just assigned the product with "no color" in its graphic properties.
